intro.screen1Body: Explore the traditional art of palmistry with AI-powered palm analysis and personalized insights about your life, relationships and personal growth.
intro.screen1ImageAlt: Illustration of an open palm with highlighted palm lines, representing AI palm analysis
intro.screen2Body: Explore tarot readings for love, career and self-discovery. Discover the symbolism of each card and find new perspectives for your journey.
intro.screen2ImageAlt: Illustration of tarot cards fanned out with a central card illuminated
intro.screen3Body: Ask questions, explore your readings and uncover personalized insights through a conversation designed around your interests and journey.
intro.screen3ImageAlt: Illustration of a chat conversation interface with a softly glowing cosmic background
